fields.name: ArgentSeaShardPersistenceOptionsValidator<TShardOptions> validation interface
fields.contract: ArgentSeaShardPersistenceOptionsValidator<TShardOptions> accepts Orleans shard-persistence options, the resolved Shard set, and its provider name. Its ValidateConfiguration operation admits the configuration only when the provider name and options shard-set key agree, query definitions are present, the resolved Shard set is nonempty, and every shard provides both members of its Read/write connection pair; otherwise the operation fails validation.
